T:P1.5.text: A trusted leader in the renal community delivering unique products to people with kidney disease.

T:P1.6.text: We are a fully integrated biopharmaceutical company. Our team works to address complications of kidney disease. We have two FDA-approved products.

T:P2.2.text: We work to develop novel therapeutics that have the potential to set new standards of care for people living with kidney disease.

T:P2.3.text: Our team is bold and optimistic.

T:P2.4.text: Since our founding we’ve put tenacity and innovation to work to develop unique therapeutics that have the potential to set new standards of care for people living with kidney disease. We have emerged as a leader with deep roots in the renal community. Today, we are a fully integrated biopharmaceutical company with an experienced nephrology-focused commercial team with a robust development organization, and partners around the globe. We currently have two FDA-approved products.

T:P2.6.text: At Akebia, we are all in on our purpose – to better the life of each person impacted by kidney disease.

T:P2.7.text: We know that big change is possible when we work together, within Akebia and well beyond our four walls. We collaborate with members of the medical and biopharmaceutical communities, as well as patient organizations.

T:P2.8.text: We are located in the biotech hub of Kendall Square in Cambridge, Massachusetts, where we are inspired by our peers and dedicated to working with our partners, patients, advocacy organizations and the broader renal community to better the life of each person impacted by kidney disease.

C:P1.1.text: Transforming how the world treats pain – Pacira BioSciences

C:P1.2.text: Better is possible. Join us in reimagining pain management with innovative, non-opioid therapies for chronic, postsurgical and musculoskeletal pain.

C:P1.4.text: More than 18 million patients have been treated with Pacira non-opioid therapies. We are building on that foundation every day.

C:P1.5.text: Our goal is to expand treatment options and partner across healthcare to make non-opioid therapies the standard, not the exception.

C:P1.6.text: Our commercial portfolio spans postsurgical, chronic, and musculoskeletal pain. Our pipeline includes a gene therapy candidate for knee osteoarthritis.

C:P1.7.text: Pain affects every part of life. We help patients understand their options and advocate for non-opioid care with their providers.

C:P1.8.text: Pacira was built on the belief that patients deserve better options. Our team works across science, education and advocacy to make that real.

C:P1.10.text: Our commercial therapies address postsurgical, chronic, and musculoskeletal pain.

C:P1.11.text: Our investigational pipeline includes PCRX-201, a gene therapy candidate for knee osteoarthritis, and is poised to transform how we approach osteoarthritis treatment with the goal of helping patients return to normal function.

C:P1.12.text: We remain committed to advancing therapies backed by rigorous, peer-reviewed clinical evidence.

C:P1.13.text: Better conversations lead to better care. We equip patients and caregivers with the resources to explore non-opioid options and partner with their providers on a plan built around them.

C:P1.14.text: Partnering to advance access, education, and advocacy

C:P1.15.text: Expanding access to non-opioid options requires working across the full healthcare system, with providers, policymakers, and patient advocates. We are committed to continuing that progress.

C:P1.16.text: Join us in making a difference

C:P1.17.text: Our teams are united by a passion for excellence and a commitment to patients.

C:P2.1.text: A leader in innovative pain management – About Pacira

C:P2.2.text: Our mission is to deliver innovative, non-opioid pain therapies to transform the lives of patients. Learn how we put our mission into action.

C:P2.3.text: Leading the future of pain management

C:P2.4.text: Pacira is shaping the future of pain management — with a portfolio of two commercial non-opioid therapies, an active pipeline, and a mission that extends well beyond the clinic.

C:P2.5.text: Our mission is to deliver innovative, non-opioid pain therapies to transform the lives of patients.

C:P2.6.text: Keep the patient at the center

C:P2.7.text: Pain is deeply personal, often overwhelming even the simplest daily tasks. Every decision we make is grounded in the needs and experiences of our patients.

C:P2.8.text: Science is the foundation upon which we build our innovations, ensuring safety, efficacy, and meaningful outcomes.

C:P2.10.text: How we do anything is how we do everything

C:P2.11.text: Our ONE Pacira culture is the fabric that unites our team’s passion for excellence and the patients we serve.

C:P2.12.text: Every day we are determined to achieve the extraordinary

C:P2.13.text: Guided by our commitment to keep the patient at the center, we recognize that every day matters for a patient suffering in pain.
